warhead.provenance: Warhead mass n/p per OOB (csg-us-sm-navy, A); Tier C commonly cites ~62 kg (Mk 125), not independently verified. Lethal radius/damage/case-explosive split are engineering-estimate surrogates following the aim_120c.json blast-fragmentation pattern, scaled up for the larger warhead mass.

fuze.provenance: OOB states radar + contact fuze (csg-us-sm-navy, A); trigger radius/delay/reliability are engineering-estimate scaffold values, no public fuze timing data (n/p).

_real_world.speed_mach: n/p; Tier C commonly cites Mach 3.5 (not verified)
_real_world.guidance_real: Inertial + Aegis midcourse command uplink; semi-active radar terminal (IIIA); SARH+IR (IIIB); requires AN/SPG-62 illumination

warhead.type.note: blast_fragmentation: no public detonation-mechanism detail (mass n/p); generic blast_fragmentation is the standard SAM warhead family assumed following the aim_120c.json pattern

warhead.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

fuze.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the sourced 90 nmi kinematic range at the used Mach 3.5 proxy speed

flight_model.max_speed.note: speed n/p (Navy); Tier C Mach 3.5 not verified in OOB pass; used as engineering estimate at sea-level Mach 3.5 ~= 1190.5 m/s

flight_model.max_g.note: no public figure; engineering estimate for a dual-thrust medium-range SAM, lower than AMRAAM (SM-2 is not a high-g dogfight missile)

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with max_g for a medium-range area-defense SAM

guidance.type.note: OOB: inertial+Aegis midcourse, semi-active radar terminal (IIIA)/SARH+IR (IIIB). Engine's guidance.type loader (unit_definition_loader.cpp:1506-1512) only recognizes ActiveRadar/Radar or IR/Infrared as seeker_type; semi-active radar has no dedicated engine category, so ActiveRadar is used as the nearest available bucket (both are radar-band terminal homing). No redesign: this is an engine mechanism gap, not a modeling choice

guidance.active_seek_range.note: 0.0: SM-2's real terminal mode is semi-active (requires ship illumination via SPG-62), not a true active seeker with its own acquisition range; set to 0 to avoid implying a self-contained active seeker capability it doesn't have

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; VLS mount override makes this documentation-only for VLS-launched use

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode is modeled beyond the semi-active homing already described

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold; no public guidance-law constant, set for a medium-range area-defense SAM, lower than ESSM's point-defense value

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, not sourced per-weapon

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold; no public figure

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold consistent with flight_model.max_g

warhead.mass_kg.note: OOB: mass n/p (A); Tier C commonly quotes ~62 kg (Mk 125), not verified

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate following the aim_120c.json blast-fragmentation pattern, scaled up for the larger warhead mass

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public damage-effectiveness figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of the proxy 62 kg total warhead mass, no public split figure

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: copied from the weapons/air_to_air/aim_120c.json blast-fragmentation projection-geometry template

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: copied/scaled from the aim_120c.json template pattern for this warhead's lethal_radius

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: copied from the aim_120c.json template pattern

fuze.type.note: OOB states radar + contact fuze; radar_proximity is the matching real engine-recognized fuze type

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: no public fuze timing data (n/p); engineering-estimate scaffold value matching warhead.lethal_radius

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data (n/p); engineering-estimate scaffold value

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold value

modeling_notes: Range (90 nmi kinematic max, A-tier) is not directly represented as a JSON field in this schema; engagement envelope vs altitude is n/p per OOB. flight_model.max_speed/max_g are the load-bearing kinematic proxies.

Engine note: for a vls_sam mount, simulation_kernel_weapon_release_service.cpp (~line 644-654) overrides the fired missile's speed/turn_rate/fuse_distance/damage/max_flight_time_s from the ship record's naval_weapon_system.mounts[] fields (projectile_speed_mps, engagement_range_m, hit_probability, damage_per_hit), not from this standalone Missile record. This record's flight_model/guidance/warhead fields are documentation/reference only for VLS-launched SM-2; the ship record's mount fields are what actually drives in-engine SM-2 engagement outcomes and must carry the sourced kinematics.
